# Collaboration and Sharing

Dimension covering real-time editing, permissions, user roles, and web
publishing. See [citations.md](../citations.md) for full source details.

## Real-Time Collaboration

"No limit on the number of people who can view and edit the same page or
database at the same time" [7]. Content is not locked when someone else is
editing — last-write-wins: "the most recent change will be reflected on the
page" [7].

"Edits, comments, and suggestions made by other people will appear to you in
real-time" [7]. Teammate avatars appear next to blocks they are actively editing;
clicking an avatar jumps to their location [7].

Users do not receive notifications for mentions on pages they currently have
open [7].

## Permission Model

Five granular permission levels [6]:

| Level | Can Edit | Can Share | Notes |
|-------|----------|-----------|-------|
| Full access | Yes | Yes | — |
| Can edit | Yes | No | — |
| Can edit content | Yes (pages/properties) | No | Database-specific; cannot alter DB structure |
| Can comment | No | No | Comments only |
| Can view | No | No | Read-only |

### Sharing Scopes [6]

1. **Only people invited** — restricted to explicitly invited individuals
2. **Everyone at {workspace}** — all members; optional "Hide in search" toggle
3. **Anyone on the web with link** — public; optional expiration dates; Enterprise
   can disable

### Permission Inheritance

Permissions flow from parent pages to subpages automatically but can be modified
individually. The "broadest access" principle applies: higher access elsewhere
supersedes restrictions [6].

Database page-level access (Business/Enterprise) restricts based on person
properties or "created by" [6].

## User Roles

| Role | Scope | Billed | Capabilities |
|------|-------|--------|-------------|
| Workspace Owner | Workspace | Yes (paid plans) | Full settings and member management [13] |
| Membership Admin | Workspace | Yes | Can manage members and guests [13] |
| Member | Workspace | Yes | Standard access, limited admin [13] |
| Guest | Page-level | No | "Can be added to individual pages, not to an entire workspace" [13] |

Groups enable "different levels of access per group" for team-based controls [13].
Guest limits vary by tier: Free allows 10, paid plans allow unlimited [3].

## Web Publishing (Notion Sites)

Publish via Share → Publish tab → Publish. Sites update automatically as
content changes [12].

| Feature | Free | Paid |
|---------|------|------|
| Published pages | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| notion.site domains | 1 | 5 (Plus+) |
| Custom slugs | No | Yes (up to 60 chars) |
| SEO (custom titles/descriptions) | No | Yes |
| Google Analytics | No | Yes |
| Custom domains | No | Yes ($8–10/month each) |

SEO caveat: "Notion Sites can take up to four weeks to be indexed and appear in
search results" [12]. Permanently deleting a published page means "its slug
cannot be reused" [12]. Enterprise can disable publishing via Settings →
Security [12].

## Obsidian Collaboration

Obsidian has no built-in real-time collaboration. Collaboration requires:

- **Obsidian Sync** — paid service ($8/month equivalent) that shares vaults
  across devices. Does not provide simultaneous editing with presence indicators.
- **Obsidian Publish** — paid service ($8/month per site) for publishing notes
  as a website [17]. Read-only; not a collaboration tool.
- **Third-party sync** — Google Drive, Dropbox, or Git can share vaults but
  risk file conflicts without merge logic.

Quote from productive.io: "The lack of good, free, cross-platform, official
syncing on Obsidian was the deal breaker" [17].

## Comparison Summary

| Capability | Notion | Obsidian |
|------------|--------|----------|
| Real-time co-editing | Yes, unlimited participants [7] | No native support |
| Presence indicators | Avatars on active blocks [7] | None |
| Permission levels | 5 granular levels [6] | File-system permissions only |
| User roles | Owner/Admin/Member/Guest [13] | Single-user (vault owner) |
| Web publishing | Built-in Notion Sites [12] | Obsidian Publish (paid add-on) |
| Guest access | Free (up to 10), unlimited on paid [3] | N/A |

## Gaps and Limitations

- Obsidian Sync and Publish pricing come from productive.io [17], not Obsidian's
  official pricing page
- Teamspace documentation was not fetched — details on teamspace types
  (Default, Open, Closed, Private) are not included
- Conflict resolution details for simultaneous editing beyond "last-write-wins"
  are sparse
